title: Power Lag
description: Generate energy by sacrificing your FPS
body:
## Tired of generators that run on boring fuel?

Coal? Lava? Uranium?

**How outdated.**

Why waste valuable resources when your friends are standing right there with 300 FPS?

Power Lag introduces a revolutionary new renewable energy source: **player performance**.

Simply place an FPS Generator and let modern hardware do what it was truly meant to do—power your factory.

***

## Why choose FPS over traditional fuels?

### Coal Generator

✅ Cheap fuel  
❌ Needs coal  
❌ Boring

### Lava Generator

✅ Good power output  
❌ Needs lava  
❌ Boring

### Nuclear Reactor

✅ Huge energy production  
❌ Expensive  
❌ Complicated  
❌ Boring

### FPS Generator

✅ Infinite fuel source\*  
✅ No mining required  
✅ Environmentally friendly  
✅ Works even better if your friend just bought a new GPU

\*As long as your friends keep playing.

***

## Features

*   ⚡ Convert nearby players' FPS into energy.
*   👥 Multiplayer support.
*   😈 Ideal for trolling your friends.

***

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Does it actually reduce FPS?**

Yes.

**Can I use my own FPS?**

Of course.

**Can I use my friend's FPS without asking?**

Technically... yes.

Whether they'll remain your friend afterwards is another question.
